title: Chorus contours
description: Faces drawn only as contours (the outline repeated in shrinking rings) on bright pastel backgrounds. Fast music makes it frantic: the background races and lurches on the beat, the rings jump apart, and heads pop in and out on the beat. A wild slider sets how far it goes.
interaction: use laptop audio, a song or the mic  ·  wild slider  ·  N new scene  ·  B new background  ·  tap to pause
